Precision and Innovation in Collet Chuck Solutions # Overview # The PRO-E Excellent Collet Chuck represents a significant advancement in tool holding technology, offering a robust and precise solution for machining centers. Engineered to surpass the performance of standard ER tool holders, the PRO-E series is designed to address the challenges of modern machining with improved runout accuracy, rigidity, and stability.
Key Features # Compatibility: Utilizes ER collets (ISO 15488), with a recommendation for ER-E High Precision Collet and ERS Metallic Series Collet, including sealed and coolant types (FOD & FID). Optimized Design: The enlarged holder ID hole enhances ER collet coverage, reduces tool overhang, and boosts machining stability. Superior Clamping: The unique upper and lower straight section design between the chuck and clamping nut ensures maximum contact, increasing strength, rigidity, and precision. Evolution of Shin-Yain Industrial Co., Ltd. (SYIC) # Shin-Yain Industrial Co., Ltd. (SYIC) has a rich history marked by innovation, expansion, and a commitment to quality in the field of machine tool accessories and solutions. Below is a chronological account of the company’s significant milestones and achievements.
Opening of affiliated company CHAIN HEADWAY MACHINE TOOLS new building to expand the business. Shin-Yain Factory B opened. Certified to ISO9001:2015 Quality Management System and ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System. Certified to TTQS Taiwan Training Quality System in bronze and received SGS ISO9001 18 Years Merit Award. Released PSC Quick Change System for Lathe. PSC tool holder went into production by grinding machine from Switzerland. 90° SAR Angle Head Holder was released. Completed construction of Shin-Yain second factory and started manufacturing. Certified to ISO 14001 Environmental Management System. Released Indexable Cutting Tools. Established company CTY TNHH SYIC VN in Ho Chi Minh City to open up Vietnam market. Released new products: 90° SAM Angle Head Holder, Power Good Clamping Nut, and DualDRIVE+ double face contact tool holders. Launched HSK tool holders for machining centers. Adopted ISO 9002 Quality Management System and Certification. Launched tool holders for machining centers, Z axial preset gauge and Rough Boring Head. Established company CHAIN HEADWAY MACHINE TOOLS and focused on the domestic market. Released new products like 5C, R8 Collet, and Milling Chuck. SYIC started to export products and participated in global exhibitions to display SYIC products. Mr. Simon Chen founded SYIC group, the products including Drill Sleeve, Lathe Center, and Bull Nose Center. Key Historical Milestones # 1979: Mr. Simon Chen founded SYIC group, initially producing Drill Sleeves, Lathe Centers, and Bull Nose Centers. 1984: SYIC began exporting products and participating in international exhibitions to showcase its offerings. 1988: Introduction of new products such as 5C, R8 Collet, and Milling Chuck. 1991: Establishment of CHAIN HEADWAY MACHINE TOOLS, focusing on the domestic market. 1998: Adoption of ISO 9002 Quality Management System and Certification. Launch of tool holders for machining centers, Z axial preset gauge, and Rough Boring Head. 2001: Launch of HSK tool holders for machining centers. 2006: Establishment of CTY TNHH SYIC VN in Ho Chi Minh City, expanding into the Vietnam market. Release of new products including the 90° SAM Angle Head Holder, Power Good Clamping Nut, and DualDRIVE+ double face contact tool holders. 2007: Certification to ISO 14001 Environmental Management System. Introduction of Indexable Cutting Tools. 2011: Completion and commencement of manufacturing at Shin-Yain’s second factory. 2012: Release of the 90° SAR Angle Head Holder. 2014: PSC tool holder production initiated using Swiss grinding machines. 2015: Certification to TTQS Taiwan Training Quality System (bronze level) and receipt of the SGS ISO9001 18 Years Merit Award. Launch of the PSC Quick Change System for Lathe. 2016: Certification to ISO9001:2015 Quality Management System and ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System. 2018: Opening of Shin-Yain Factory B. 2019: Opening of the new building for affiliated company CHAIN HEADWAY MACHINE TOOLS, further expanding business operations. SYIC continues to uphold its dedication to quality, innovation, and global presence in the machine tool industry.
